title: PIN#057270000481_ First Aid Kits, AEDs and Replenishment Service
agency_path: City of New York > Fire Department
description_text:
Pursuant to Section 3-05 of the NYC Procurement Policy Board Rules the New York City Fire Department (FDNY) intends to enter into sole source negotiations with REDICARE LLC. to provide First Aid Kits, AEDs and the monthly service. The service provided by RediCare includes monthly inventory control. Anything expired, missing or low supply is exchanged, replaced and refilled on a monthly basis. Were requesting one annual payment to keep the cost to a minimum.

- First AID Cabinet Service (FAC-1400 SERIES): 21 Units
- AED Service and Parts Included (AED-2100 SERIES): 10 Units
- Eyewash Station Service and Parts included (EWS-3100 SERIES): 2 Units
- Eyewash Station Service - Service and Parts included (EWS-3200 SERIES): 18 Units
- Responder Bag Service - Service and Parts included (FAB-4300 SERIES): 1 Unit
- Management Suite Seat (REDI365): 5 Units

Any vendor, besides REDICARE LLC., that believes they can provide the First Aid Kits, AEDs and the monthly service is invited to express their interest by submitting a response in PASSPort. Please complete the Acknowledgement tab and submit a response in the Manage Responses Questionnaire tab. If you have questions about the details of the RFx please submit them through the Discussion with buyer tab. 

This Request for Information (RFI) is being released through PASSPort. Responses to this RFI shall only be submitted via PASSPort. To access the RFI visit the PASSPort and click on the Procurement Navigator' button. To locate the RFI, insert EPIN# 05727Y0677 into the Keywords search field.

Instructions on how to submit your responses in PASSPort can be found at the link below:
https://www.nyc.gov/site/mocs/passport/articles/respond-opportunities.page

If you have questions regarding this RFI, please submit these through the Discussion Forum of the subject Epin in the PASSPort system.
